sprayWindows.title: POST broadleaf scout window (V2–V3)
sprayWindows.body: Scout block; if ≥3 broadleaves per 10 sq ft, plan a 2,4-D spray. Block-level lockout if companions are co-planted.

sprayWindows.title: POST grass + late broadleaf window (V4–V6)
sprayWindows.body: Window for Mesotrione + Stadia. Verify decon if sprayer last ran auxin.
